name: agentsmd-lazyload
description: Codex hook that lazily injects nested AGENTS.md files into the model context the first time a tool call touches their folder.

scripts.start: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js demo --lang en
scripts.test: npm run build --silent && vitest run --exclude test/conformance.test.ts
scripts.test:conformance: npm run build --silent && vitest run test/conformance.test.ts
